message.content:
In this repository (Blackbox, a TypeScript record/replay debugger for AI agents), add one regression test proving that when a recorded run is replayed with a different model name in the request, strict replay stops with a ReplayDivergenceError whose path is "model".

- Put it in tests/session.test.ts, inside the describe("replay", ...) block, reusing helpers already defined in that file (recordWeather, anthropicClient, noNetwork).
- The file is long: use Grep to find what you need and Read with offset/limit instead of reading it whole.
- If node_modules is missing in your working directory, run `ln -s ../../node_modules node_modules` is NOT allowed; instead just run the tests with `npx vitest run tests/session.test.ts` and tell me if dependencies are missing.
- Run `npx vitest run tests/session.test.ts` and iterate until it passes.
- Do not change anything under src/. Do not commit.
- Finish with two sentences: what you added, and the test result.

input.message: I added one test, "stops strict replay when the request names a different model", to the `describe("replay", ...)` block in tests/session.test.ts. It records a run with `recordWeather`, then replays it with `noNetwork` and `anthropicClient` while sending the recorded first request under a different model name (`claude-opus-5` instead of `claude-sonnet-5`), and checks that `bb.finish()` rejects with a `ReplayDivergenceError` at `stepIndex` 0 whose `path` is `"model"`. `npx vitest run tests/session.test.ts` passed on the first run (38 of 38): the worktree has no `node_modules` of its own, but vitest found the packages in the parent repository's copy, so nothing is missing. Nothing under `src/` was changed and nothing was committed; the test file is the only change in `git status`.

content.text:
I added a test to the replay tests in `tests/session.test.ts` that replays a recorded run with a different model name and checks that strict replay stops with a `ReplayDivergenceError` at the first model call, with its path set to `"model"`. `npx vitest run tests/session.test.ts` passed on the first run (38 of 38): the worktree has no `node_modules` of its own, but vitest used the main repository's copy, so no dependencies are missing.

The test builds the request itself rather than going through the weather agent, because the agent always sends `claude-sonnet-5`. Nothing under `src/` was changed and nothing was committed; the test file is the only change.
